title: Why pain biomarkers cannot replace the patient experience
abstract: Nature Neuroscience, Published online: 01 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41593-026-02324-x Using neuroimaging to understand the mechanisms of pain is an important task. But we must understand that the gold standard of measuring pain will always be the self-report.
